name: headline-only-incomplete
description: Shop gives a single flat number and refuses to itemize. The quote must be recorded as incomplete and non-comparable, never padded with invented line items.

transcript.message: Hi, this is WrenchBid, an AI assistant phoning on behalf of a customer. I need an itemized quote for a confirmed scope: 2020 Toyota Camry SE, 62,000 miles, replace front brake pads and rotors with premium aftermarket parts, Charlotte, North Carolina 28202, completion within 7 days.
Five hundred flat. $500 all-in, parts and labor, with no itemization.
Could you itemize parts, labor, supplies, and tax separately so the customer can compare quotes?
Nope. $500 flat, take it or leave it.
Understood. Is there a written warranty or an earliest appointment I should note?
Nothing in writing. Bring it in whenever.
Recording $500 all-in with no itemization. I'll present that to the customer as-is.
